cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: A fresh start asks for a leap of faith. Stay curious and open to what is new.
cards.reversed: Hesitation or carelessness. Pause to check the ground before you step.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: You already hold the tools you need. Gather your attention and act with intent.
cards.reversed: Scattered energy or unused talent. Ask what is holding your focus back.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: Quiet reflection brings answers that noise cannot. Trust what you sense beneath the surface.
cards.reversed: Ignoring your inner voice, or keeping something hidden from yourself.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: Care, comfort and growth are available. Tend what you love and let it flourish.
cards.reversed: Smothering, neglecting yourself, or a creative block.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Clear boundaries and steady planning create a solid base. Lead with calm.
cards.reversed: Rigidity or control. Ask where firmness has become stubbornness.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.upright: Learning from established wisdom or community can steady you.
cards.reversed: Questioning rules that no longer fit. Find your own path to meaning.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: A meaningful choice that reflects your values, or a bond that asks for honesty.
cards.reversed: Misalignment or indecision. Check whether your actions match what you value.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Willpower and focus move you forward. Hold the reins steady.
cards.reversed: Losing direction, or pushing too hard without a plan.

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: Quiet courage and gentleness handle what force cannot.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt or running on empty. Rebuild confidence in small steps.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: Step back to think. Time alone can show you what matters.
cards.reversed: Isolation or avoiding reflection. Balance solitude with connection.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: Things turn in cycles. Adapt to change and look for what it offers.
cards.reversed: Resisting change or feeling stuck in a loop. Look for what you can influence.

cards.name: Justice
cards.upright: Weigh the facts honestly. Clear, fair choices bring balance.
cards.reversed: Bias, dodging responsibility, or an unbalanced view.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.upright: Stopping to see differently can unlock a stuck situation.
cards.reversed: Stalling without purpose. Ask whether waiting is still helping.

cards.name: Death
cards.upright: One chapter closes so another can begin. Let go of what has run its course.
cards.reversed: Clinging to the past or fearing a needed change.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.upright: Blend opposing needs with patience. Steady, measured steps work best.
cards.reversed: Excess or impatience. Look for where things are out of balance.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.upright: Notice what holds you, whether a habit, a belief or a dependency, and how much choice you really have.
cards.reversed: Loosening a grip. Awareness is the first step toward freedom.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.upright: A sudden shake-up reveals what was not stable. Clear ground makes room to rebuild.
cards.reversed: Fear of change or a slow-burning problem. Face it rather than wait.

cards.name: The Star
cards.upright: Gentle hope returns after a hard stretch. Rest and trust a slow recovery.
cards.reversed: Doubt or low motivation. Be kind to yourself and keep small hopes alive.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.upright: Things are not fully clear. Move carefully and notice your fears and instincts.
cards.reversed: Confusion lifting, or anxiety that needs grounding.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.upright: Warmth, confidence and openness. Enjoy what is going well.
cards.reversed: Dimmed enthusiasm or too much ego. Look for small sources of light.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.upright: A moment of honest review. Forgive the past and answer your inner call.
cards.reversed: Self-criticism or avoiding a necessary decision.

cards.name: The World
cards.upright: A cycle completes. Take stock of how far you have come.
cards.reversed: Loose ends or a finish that feels out of reach. One last step remains.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.upright: A burst of enthusiasm and a chance to start something bold.
cards.reversed: Low energy or a false start. Nurture the idea before you rush.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.upright: You stand at the edge of what is familiar. Decide where to aim.
cards.reversed: Fear of leaving comfort, or plans that stay on paper.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.upright: Early efforts are moving. Look further ahead and keep going.
cards.reversed: Delays or a narrow view. Widen your outlook.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.upright: A moment of rest and shared joy after effort.
cards.reversed: Unease at home or a celebration that feels hollow.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.upright: Clashing ideas and rivalry. Competition can sharpen you if kept friendly.
cards.reversed: Avoiding conflict, or tension turning inward.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.upright: Public success or a boost of confidence for your efforts.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt or craving praise. Measure success on your own terms.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.upright: You hold your ground. Stay firm on what you believe.
cards.reversed: Feeling overwhelmed or giving up too soon.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.upright: Things move fast. Act promptly and keep communication open.
cards.reversed: Delays or scattered effort. Slow down to regroup.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.upright: Tired but nearly there. Draw on your resilience.
cards.reversed: Burnout or stubbornness. Rest may be wiser than another round.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.upright: You are carrying a lot. Consider what you can set down.
cards.reversed: Dropping a burden, or struggling to ask for help.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.upright: A spirited newcomer, eager to explore and try ideas.
cards.reversed: Impatience or half-finished projects.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.upright: Bold, restless energy that charges ahead.
cards.reversed: Recklessness or frustration. Think before you leap.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.upright: Confident, welcoming and driven. Lead by inspiring.
cards.reversed: Insecurity or jealousy. Reconnect with your own spark.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.upright: A natural leader with a clear vision.
cards.reversed: Domineering or impulsive leadership.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.upright: An opening of the heart. Welcome kindness and emotional renewal.
cards.reversed: Feelings held back. Allow yourself to feel.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.upright: A balanced bond built on respect and shared feeling.
cards.reversed: Imbalance or miscommunication in a relationship.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.upright: Joy shared with others. Enjoy good company.
cards.reversed: Overindulgence, or feeling left out.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.upright: Boredom or withdrawal. Ask what you truly want.
cards.reversed: Waking up to new options after a dull patch.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.upright: Focus on what is lost. Remember that some cups still stand.
cards.reversed: Moving on, forgiveness and slowly turning toward what remains.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.upright: Memories and gentle generosity. Revisit the past with warmth.
cards.reversed: Stuck in the past, or looking back instead of ahead.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.upright: Many possibilities and some fantasy. Sort the real from the imagined.
cards.reversed: Clarity arrives, or choices that overwhelm.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.upright: Leaving something that no longer satisfies in search of meaning.
cards.reversed: Aimless drifting, or fear of leaving.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.upright: A sense of fulfilment. Appreciate what you have.
cards.reversed: Smugness or a wish that is not as satisfying as expected.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional fulfilment and a sense of belonging.
cards.reversed: Strained bonds, or values that do not quite line up.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.upright: A tender, creative message. Listen to your feelings.
cards.reversed: Moodiness or emotional immaturity.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.upright: A dreamer who follows the heart. Offers or invitations may come.
cards.reversed: Unrealistic ideas or mixed signals.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.upright: Deeply caring and intuitive. Look after yourself too.
cards.reversed: Emotional overwhelm or neglecting your own needs.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.upright: Mature, steady and compassionate. Keep calm under pressure.
cards.reversed: Suppressed feelings or moodiness hiding behind composure.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.upright: A clear idea cuts through confusion. Speak and think plainly.
cards.reversed: Muddled thinking or harsh words.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.upright: A hard choice you are avoiding. Remove the blindfold when ready.
cards.reversed: Information comes to light, or indecision drags on.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.upright: Painful truth or sadness. Acknowledge it so it can heal.
cards.reversed: Recovery begins, or you are holding on to pain.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.upright: Pause and recharge. Rest is productive.
cards.reversed: Restlessness or returning to action too soon.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.upright: A fight that costs more than it gains. Choose your battles.
cards.reversed: Making peace, or lingering resentment.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.upright: A slow move away from trouble. Healing is underway.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change, or unresolved baggage.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.upright: Think carefully; a sly approach needs honesty about its cost.
cards.reversed: Coming clean, or a plan that backfires.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.upright: You feel stuck, though options may be more open than they seem.
cards.reversed: Freeing yourself, and seeing choices again.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.upright: Worry looms large. Share it with someone you trust.
cards.reversed: Fears easing, or anxiety that needs support.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.upright: A painful chapter ends. The only direction now is forward.
cards.reversed: Recovery begins, or you cling to the past.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.upright: A sharp, inquisitive mind. Ask questions and gather facts.
cards.reversed: Gossip, haste or scattered thoughts.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.upright: Driven and quick to act. Watch for bluntness.
cards.reversed: Burning out, or acting without thinking.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.upright: Clear-eyed and fair. Speak the truth kindly.
cards.reversed: Coldness or being overly critical.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.upright: Logical, principled and decisive. Seek fairness.
cards.reversed: Rigid thinking or misuse of power.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.upright: A seed of opportunity in work or money. Plant it carefully.
cards.reversed: A missed chance or poor planning.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.upright: Juggling priorities with flexibility. Keep your rhythm.
cards.reversed: Overcommitting or disorganisation.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.upright: Skilled collaboration. Good work grows through cooperation.
cards.reversed: Poor teamwork or work below your usual standard.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.upright: Holding on to what you have. Security is good; watch for clinging.
cards.reversed: Generosity returns, or tight control loosens.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.upright: A lean time. Help exists if you reach for it.
cards.reversed: Recovery, or refusing to ask for support.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.upright: Giving and receiving in balance. Be fair with resources.
cards.reversed: Strings attached, or one-sided exchange.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.upright: Pause to review your efforts. Growth takes time.
cards.reversed: Impatience or doubting your progress.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.upright: Steady, focused work builds skill.
cards.reversed: Perfectionism or repetitive work with no purpose.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.upright: Enjoy what your effort has built.
cards.reversed: Overwork, or comfort that feels empty.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.upright: Long-term stability, family and shared wealth.
cards.reversed: Family friction or short-term thinking.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.upright: A hardworking student of life, eager to learn and build.
cards.reversed: Procrastination or lack of focus.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.upright: Dependable and thorough. Slow and steady wins.
cards.reversed: Stubbornness, boredom or perfectionism.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.upright: Warm, practical and generous. Create comfort for yourself and others.
cards.reversed: Self-neglect or smothering.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.upright: Established, generous and secure. Lead steadily.
cards.reversed: Greed, stubbornness or valuing money over people.
